355217.claim: G8 = triangles {0,1,6},{2,3,7}, hub edge 67, twins 4,5 adjacent to 6 and 7: gamma~c(G8) = 4 = gamma~c(M(G8)), so gamma~c(G) < gamma~c(M(G)) fails. Infinite family G_{a,b} (a,b>=1, n=2a+2b+4) with equality. Lemma: for even n, gamma~c(M(G)) = n/2 iff G has a perfect matching F with G-F connected.
355217.search_coverage: all connected graphs of order 2..8 (1,1,2,6,21,112,853,11117 graphs; canonical generation counts match OEIS A000088/A001349). No counterexample for n<=7; G8 is the unique connected counterexample at n=8 (equality case).
355217.domain_note: Literal statement also fails trivially for the edgeless graph on 2 vertices (M(G)=G); that domain defect is NOT claimed. G8 is connected, so it refutes the intended connected form.
